name: skill-marketplace
description: The shared skill registry and marketplace: search, profiles, ranking, impact, governance, lifecycle, gaps, recommendations and ratings. Reads approved skills only.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search the shared skill registry (approved skills) before building a new skill.

tools.name: get_skill_info
tools.description: Profile of one approved skill from the shared registry (no skill text).

tools.name: list_skill_catalog
tools.description: Skill marketplace overview: counts per board area, LOB, team and reach, with the skills; filterable.

tools.name: get_skill_ranking
tools.description: Top skills by demand (installs, views, search hits), filterable by board area, LOB, team or reach.

tools.name: get_skill_impact
tools.description: Skill impact: runs, success, time saved, value and run cost per skill (sample data).

tools.name: get_skill_governance
tools.description: Skill governance: EU AI Act class, DPIA, reviews due, linked risks and agents (sample data).

tools.name: get_skill_lifecycle
tools.description: Skill lifecycle: change log, dependencies, tests, sunset, deputy; who depends on what (sample data).

tools.name: find_skill_gaps
tools.description: Processes without a skill and skill requests from the teams, with potential hours (sample data).

tools.name: recommend_skills
tools.description: Recommend skills for a role and/or a task with example prompts and demo flow.

tools.name: recommend_skill_workflow
tools.description: Recommend an ordered sequence of marketplace skills for a role and/or a goal, so the person does not need to know every skill. Example: role "Account Manager", goal "Kundentermin und Verlängerung" returns the steps customer-call-prep, renewal-radar, quote-drafter and ticket-writer, each with why, input, output, maturity, risk class and warnings (sunset, replaced, not in the registry). Use it for "In welcher Reihenfolge nutze ich welche Skills …?". Sample playbooks.

tools.name: get_skill_ratings
tools.description: Star ratings of marketplace skills (1 to 5, anonymous, one rating per person). Without a name: ranking of all skills by a damped average (a skill with two five-star votes does not beat one with 40 votes at 4.6); skills with fewer than 5 ratings are marked "new". With a name: average, number of ratings, how many gave 1 to 5 stars, and the latest comments. Answers "Welche Skills sind am besten bewertet?" or "Wie wird ticket-writer bewertet?". Live from Supabase when connected, otherwise sample data.

tools.name: rate_skill
tools.description: Rate a published marketplace skill with 1 to 5 stars and an optional short comment (max 280 characters). One rating per person and skill; rating again replaces the earlier one. Ask the person for the stars first and repeat skill, stars and comment back before calling; never rate on your own. Do not put names, customer data or secrets into the comment. Needs the Supabase connection; sample skills cannot be rated.

supabase_url.title: Supabase project URL
supabase_url.description: Optional. Example: https://<project-ref>.supabase.co. Leave empty to use the bundled sample data.

supabase_secret_key.title: Supabase secret key
supabase_secret_key.description: Optional. Server-side secret key (sb_secret_…) of that project. Stored as a secret, never written to config files.
